dedupe_keys.name: aon impact forecasting catastrophe models elements platform and hazard and risk scores

description: Impact Forecasting is Aon's catastrophe model developer. It offers more than 135 probabilistic and scenario models spanning 12 perils and almost 90 territories, which insurers and reinsurers use to analyse the financial impact of catastrophic events for reinsurance, underwriting and exposure management. The models run in the ELEMENTS platform, which also includes the Oasis financial loss engine besides Impact Forecasting's own engine, reads the Oasis model definition format natively, offers a full set of APIs and installs as client-server software on premises or in the cloud. Users can adjust model parameters, add events, customise vulnerability functions and quantify uncertainty; ELEMENTS 16 supports Open Exposure Data modifiers. Hazard and risk data products give hazard intensity (hazard scores) and modelled loss ratios (risk scores) per return period for each postal or administrative zone, for eight perils in nearly 40 countries, based on thousands of stochastic events. An automated event response service uses weather forecast and station data. Coverage: global peak zones and emerging markets. Format and access: licensed software and data with account support. Licence: proprietary; terms and prices were not read. Caveats: the list of perils and territories was not read; results are financial losses. Simulation uses: stochastic hazard and loss estimates for exposure and resilience studies. Related records: the Oasis LMF (platform-oasis-lmf) and KatRisk (model-katrisk-catastrophe-models-and-hazard-data).
